stem: Formative: Why should repeated PPFD measurements use the same sensor orientation and canopy plane?
choices: Because orientation changes nutrient uptake directly.
To make the measurements comparable and reduce geometry-driven differences.
Because PPFD is a room-average value only.
Because all sensors auto-correct any geometry change.
rationale: To make the measurements comparable and reduce geometry-driven differences. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
